# Steady 2.21.18

- **Room DB:** Removed silent `fallbackToDestructiveMigration()`. Explicit additive migrations v1→v8, schema export on, pre-upgrade file backup. App categories / to-dos / usage no longer wiped on schema bumps. (PIN, schedules, and most rules already live in DataStore and were never in this DB.)
- **Mail API:** Browser no longer ships or sends the Resend key. Worker mints a short-lived HMAC token (`/api/mail/token`) — same server-secret pattern as `LAB_GATE`.
- **APK:** Resend API key no longer baked into BuildConfig.
